EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Today's the day to pull up all the
weeds in town!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}} And quite possibly
a few flowers by mistake.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hoy es el día de arrancar todos los
hierbajos del pueblo!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}} Espero que
nadie arranque flores por error{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aujourd'hui, il faut faire la chasse
aux mauvaises herbes ! {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}En évitant
d'arracher des fleurs au passage...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oggi ripuliamo la città da tuuutte
le erbacce...{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}} Cerca di non strappare
via troppi fiori per errore!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugün kasabadaki bütün yabani otları yolma günü!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}
Yanlışlıkla birkaç çiçek de gidebilir tabii.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A hard day spent pulling weeds can
leave you tired but satisfied.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Arrancar hierbajos de sol a sol es
un trabajo agotador,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} pero también
muy gratificante,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¿sabes?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ce n'est pas une sinécure d'arracher
les mauvaises herbes, mais quelle
satisfaction quand on a terminé !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dopo una giornata passata
a eliminare le erbacce mi sento
sempre mooolto soddisfatta di me.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Es ist anstrengend, Unkraut zu
jäten, aber danach fühlt man sich
gut, weil man was geleistet hat.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bütün günü ot yolayarak geçirmek insanı
yorar ama sonunda
güzel bir tatmin duygusu bırakır.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Stopping to pull up weeds all the
time isn't fun,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but a day like today
shows you why it's necessary!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ir por ahí arrancando hierbajos
no parece lo más divertido del
mundo,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} no te voy a mentir.
¡Pero días como este te recuerdan
que también es algo indispensable!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Verás lo bonito que queda el pueblo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}J'ai connu plus amusant qu'arracher
des mauvaises herbes du matin au
soir, mais il faut ce qu'il faut !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Strappare via le erbacce
non è un lavoro divertente...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ma quando poi vedo la città
bella e pulita, sono davvero
contentissimissima!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Unkraut zu jäten macht zwar nicht
besonders viel Spaß, aber lohnen
tut es sich allemal!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sürekli durup ot yolmak pek eğlenceli
değil,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama bugünkü
gibi bir gün bunun neden gerekli
olduğunu hatırlatıyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Since today is the day for cleaning
up the town,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} I thought I'd clean up
my room too!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Como hoy te estás dedicando a
limpiar el pueblo,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} me he propuesto
poner en orden mi habitación.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Puisque le grand ménage a lieu en
ville, autant en profiter pour ranger
ma chambre dans la foulée !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Visto che tutti stanno lavorando
per pulire la città,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} io ho pensato
di riordinare il mio pied-à-terre.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Da du heute die Stadt sauber
machst, dachte ich, ich könnte ja
meine Wohnung sauber machen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bugün kasabayı temizleme günü olduğuna
göre,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} ben de odamı
temizleyeyim dedim!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It's so nice to live in a town where
the residents pitch in together to
keep it clean.
I'll be doing my part too!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Just not
by pulling weeds.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Es una delicia vivir en un pueblo
como este,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} donde los vecinos se
esfuerzan por mantenerlo limpio.
¡Yo también pondré de mi parte!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Aunque no sea arrancando
malas hierbas.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ça fait plaisir de voir tous les
habitants se serrer les coudes pour
que la ville soit propre.
Il ne sera pas dit que je n'aurai pas
fait ma part !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}È bello vivere in un posto dove tutti
si impegnano per tenere pulita
la città.
Anche io voglio fare la mia parte!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Ho deciso che posso iniziare
riordinando il mio pied-à-terre.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Herkesin el ele verip kasabayı temiz
tuttuğu bir yerde
yaşamak gerçekten çok güzel.
Ben de üzerime düşeni yapacağım!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Yalnız
ot yolayarak değil.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pulling up weeds is boring,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but it's
a necessary chore.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Thanks for
taking care of it.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}We can't expect to attract visitors
if the town gets too dirty or
run down!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Arrancar hierbajos es bastante
aburrido,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} pero hay que hacerlo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}No podemos animar a la gente
a mudarse a nuestro pueblo si
lo tenemos todo patas arriba.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Quelle barbe d'arracher les
mauvaises herbes ! Enfin, on ne
fait pas toujours ce qu'on veut.
Habiter une ville bien entretenue
implique parfois de se retrousser
les manches !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Strappare via le erbacce è davvero
noioso,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ma è una cosa che va fatta.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Una città pulita attira mooolti
più turisti! Ci avevi mai pensato?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Es ist zwar sicher langweilig,
das ganze Unkraut rauszurupfen,
aber es ist eben notwendig.
Schließlich soll unsere Stadt doch
schön und gepflegt sein, damit wir
viele neue Nachbarn bekommen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ot yolmak sıkıcı,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama yapılması gereken bir iş.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
İlgilendiğin için teşekkür ederim.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Kasaba
fazla kirlenip bakımsızlaşırsa
ziyaretçilerin gelmesini bekleyemeyiz!
